subject: Verifying monthly burn slot & PO authority for EverFlow pilot
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Solomon <ari@everflow.ai>, procurement@everflow.ai
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Verifying monthly burn slot & PO authority for EverFlow pilot

Hi Ari / team — thanks again for the call today. Quick written recap so we have alignment and a clear next-step checklist.

Key points from discovery:
- Estimated steady-state token profiles we discussed:
  • Small pilot: 2–5M tokens / month
  • Ramp / integration: 10–15M tokens / month
  • Production target (ML + search + background tasks): 40–60M tokens / month
- Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: ~$400–$600 per 1M tokens depending on model variant and commitment.
- Procurement threshold we heard: PO or contract review kicks in when monthly spend exceeds ~$20k (or equivalent annualized). Please correct me if that’s not accurate.

Preliminary budget math (for alignment):
- 2M @ $400–$600 per 1M => ~$800–$1,200 / month
- 10M @ $400–$600 per 1M => ~$4k–$6k / month
- 50M @ $400–$600 per 1M => ~$20k–$30k / month (this is the band where a PO/contract will likely be needed)

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether the PO threshold is indeed $20k/mo (or if EverFlow uses a different cutoff)?
2) Is Net-30 acceptable for billing, and do you require any special invoicing fields (cost center, project code)?
3) If we lock a 3-month pilot at the 10–15M band, do you need a formal quote / signature to start vendor onboarding, or can we start on a test-card while legal completes paperwork?

I’ve attached a draft quote (Redwood-quote-EF-20261127.pdf) with banded pricing and a short SOC2 summary to accelerate vendor onboarding. Jordan — looping you in to validate the math and confirm the recommended pilot band from our side. Naomi — can you jump in on the PO/finance details if EverFlow confirms PO is required?

Thanks — I’ll hold next-step items until we hear confirmation from procurement.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
pri@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0196

Attachments:
- Redwood-quote-EF-20261127.pdf (banded quote, draft)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (one-page SOC2 excerpt)

From: Ari Solomon <ari@everflow.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@everflow.ai, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@everflow.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Verifying monthly burn slot & PO authority for EverFlow pilot

Thanks for the clear recap, Priyom — helpful. A few answers / clarifications from procurement side: 

- PO threshold: our internal policy requires a PO for recurring vendor spend > $10k/month OR any single invoice > $50k. The $20k figure is conservative on our side but we can operate with the $10k floor.
- Payment terms: Net-30 is OK, but our AP team asks for a detailed vendor onboarding form and SOC2 report before we issue the first PO. I attached the onboarding form (everflow-vendor-onboard-form.pdf) — it has the fields we need for finance and tax.
- Invoicing fields: Please make sure invoices can include our project code (EV-PL-2026) and our cost center (Prod-ML).

Regarding pilot sizing: Legal prefers a short SOW + PO for anything expected to exceed $5k/month. For a 3-month pilot at 10–15M tokens / month, expect the PO + vendor onboarding to be required.

Can you confirm the exact monthly spend estimate (range) for the 3-month pilot so I can loop Legal and AP? Also please confirm you can provide a short SOW / quote we can sign (PDF or DocuSign).

Appreciate it — looking forward to next steps.

—Ari
Head of Product | EverFlow.ai
ari@everflow.ai | +1 (617) 222-3300

Attachment: everflow-vendor-onboard-form.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Solomon <ari@everflow.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Verifying monthly burn slot & PO authority for EverFlow pilot

Ari — thanks for the quick clarity on thresholds. Short answers from our side and a concrete pilot quote option: 

- We can provide a 3-month pilot SOW + quote for the 10–15M tokens / month band.
- Pricing bands (as shown in the attached draft) are: $400 / 1M (commit tier) to $600 / 1M (no commit, burst).

Concrete estimate for the 3-month pilot (10–15M / month):
- Low: 10M * $400/1M = $4,000 / month -> $12k over 3 months
- High: 15M * $600/1M = $9,000 / month -> $27k over 3 months

Given EverFlow’s PO threshold at $10k/month, the low end (10M @ $400) is under the PO cutoff; the high end would trigger PO and onboarding. Recommendation: structure the pilot as a capped PO at $27k for three months, with the option to increase and issue a follow-up PO if you hit the higher usage. That keeps Legal/AP happy and lets you ramp without a long-term commit.

Naomi — can you confirm we can accept Net-30 on the SOW and add the EV-PL-2026 project code on invoices? Also please confirm finance is comfortable with us issuing an initial invoice once the PO is received.

Priyom — I attached the draft quote (Redwood-quote-EF-20261127.pdf) and the SOC2 snippet. If EverFlow is good with the capped PO approach I’ll convert the quote into an SOW/DocuSign template.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood-quote-EF-20261127.pdf

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@everflow.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ari Solomon <ari@everflow.ai>
Cc: procurement@everflow.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Verifying monthly burn slot & PO authority for EverFlow pilot

Jordan / Priyom — this looks reasonable. We’d like the SOW and capped PO approach. Confirming the following so AP can start the onboarding flow: 

1) Please provide the final SOW/quote with the following line items and totals so we can issue PO: 
   - Pilot SOW (3 months) — capped not-to-exceed $27,000
   - Onboarding support (one-time): $1,500 (optional — indicate as separate line)
2) Net-30 is acceptable; include project code EV-PL-2026 on invoices.
3) Please attach your full SOC2 report or the SOC2 point-of-contact so our security team can complete the checklist. The SOC2 summary you included is fine to start, but we need the full report on file before the long-term contract.

If you can push the updated SOW/DocuSign today we’ll start the PO routing; expected AP processing time is ~5 business days once the onboarding form and SOW are in.

Thanks — Lena
Director, Procurement | EverFlow.ai
procurement@everflow.ai

Quoted attachments referenced in-thread: Redwood-quote-EF-20261127.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, everflow-vendor-onboard-form.pdf
